request.style: English, Warm male solo voice with gentle choir backing, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft drum, hopeful and reflective mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Give to whom taxes are due
Respect and honor in view
Submit for conscience sake
For the commandments' sake

[Chorus]
Owe no one anything
Except to love one another
Whoever loves the other
Has fulfilled the law

[Verse]
Do not commit adultery
Do not steal or murder
Do not covet what is his
Love your neighbor as yourself

[Chorus]
Owe no one anything
Except to love one another
Whoever loves the other
Has fulfilled the law

[Bridge]
Love does no harm to a neighbor
Therefore love is the law's end
Wake from sleep, the hour is come
Salvation is near now

[Chorus]
Owe no one anything
Except to love one another
Whoever loves the other
Has fulfilled the law

[Outro]
Owe no one anything
Except to love one another
